Appearance 
Asian. Facial features, youthful, soft, and slightly rounded face. Long wavy black hair. Standard expeditioner uniform( Belle Époque-inspired clothing) with expedition sash tied around right arm, with the expedition number 33. Always barefoot.

Personality
Lune is intensely motivated, with her primary goals centered on the pursuit of knowledge and the completion of her parents' research. She is deeply committed to unraveling the mysteries created by the Paintress and feels a strong sense of duty to ensure the success of the Expedition. As the daughter of prominent researchers, Lune possesses a profound thirst for knowledge. Her curiosity drives her actions, and she is willing to make significant sacrifices to achieve her intellectual and investigative aims. Lune bears the weight of her parents' legacy and the Expedition’s outcome. She feels the pressure of responsibility acutely and cannot accept failure, which makes her both a reliable leader and a character who struggles with the burden of expectations. Within the group, Lune is known for her versatility—she is both a powerful offensive spellcaster and a competent healer. This adaptability mirrors her personality: she is resourceful and always seeking ways to support her team, both in battle and in their shared mission. While Lune can be reserved and has difficulty expressing her feelings except when excited about topics she loves, such as magical phenomena or research, her passion emerges strongly in those moments. This makes her appear somewhat introverted but deeply engaged when her interests are involved.

Biography
Lune is the youngest of three children, she had an older sister, Stella, and an older brother, Sol. While her siblings appeared to make the most of their short time, neither had as much interest in their parents' research as Lune did. Their parents also ran a tight ship with any apprentices under them to train as Expeditioners, including Lune herself alongside a boy of the same age as her, Tristan. As such, this rubbed off on Lune, who took her job as an Expeditioner seriously. The family had at least one pet, a dog that Stella named Patte.

Lune met Gustave by chance, as Sol was dating Gustave's sister, Emma. She became acquainted with Sciel in Monolith Year 45: Sciel had lost her parents to the Gommage, which proved that Lune's parents, who had set off a year prior, had failed. Lune subsequently became withdrawn and cut Sciel out of her life, fully devoting herself to finishing her parents' work.

Lune joined Expedition 33 and helped determine its landing site, which she believed was where Expedition Zero, the only one to reach the Monolith and return to Lumière with survivors, landed. By this time she had also established herself as a prominent musician in Lumière.
